signal: StreamlineTM launched DocAccess for ADA-compliant public documents and was acquired by CivicPlus in December 2025, ahead of the April 2026 government accessibility deadline.

email.body1:
Yenni, saw Streamline launched DocAccess and joined CivicPlus, right before the April 2026 government accessibility deadline.

A timed compliance window like that surfaces more special districts that need to act than the team can reach, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Streamline off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Yenni, quick follow-up for Streamline.

The April 2026 deadline is a hard window, and demand will outpace what the team can reach manually. Most sales leaders cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the window closes.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Streamline needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Yenni, last bit of proof for Streamline.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Streamline's reply rate likely compares to peer govtech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
